lines.en: Sssss as it moves

lines.zh: 步履蹒跚，发出金属摩擦声
lines.en: Grinding metal with each step
Heavy steps, muffled sound

lines.zh: 脚步声中夹杂着金属摩擦
lines.en: Metallic scrape amid its steps
Slowly moving, metallic clinks

lines.zh: 移动时发出铁器碰撞声
lines.en: Iron clatters as it moves
Constant scrape with each step

lines.zh: 步履声中夹杂着金属摩擦
lines.en: Metallic scrape in its steps
It drags its barrel down the corridor.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着弹壳的响。
lines.en: Each step clicks with spent casings.

lines.zh: 它侧身穿过门框，枪口先到。
lines.en: It angles through the door, muzzle first.
It swaps a magazine without breaking stride.
Stares into the distance
Bitterly silent, full of malice
Silent and vigilant
The chamber's cold — I wait a moment.
Blank stare, filled with malice
Danger lurks in its silence
Waiting silently for its prey
Silent with power
Silent, waiting for something
Planning an ambush in silence

lines.zh: 黄铜枪管从肩后探出来。
lines.en: The brass barrel slides out from behind my shoulder.
Holding you in sight, ready to shoot
The finger on the trigger tightens.
Finger on trigger — target is you.
Aiming at you, ready to shoot
Staring at you, ready to fire
Aiming at you, ready to attack
I tilt my head, muzzle steady on you.
Targeting player, ready to shoot

lines.zh: 它抬起头，枪口跟着动了。
lines.en: It lifts its head and the muzzle follows.
Wounds are deep, run!
My armor is damaged!

lines.zh: 我受伤了，求求你帮帮我！
lines.en: I'm hurt, please help me!
An armor plate has fallen off; it hurts.
This place is dangerous! Go!
Under the bandages, I'm still moving.
Don't hit me!
My ammo crate is empty.
I'm defeated!

lines.zh: 别过来，我的枪还没上膛。
lines.en: Stay back — my gun isn't loaded yet.
I don't take what's in your hand.
Not much ammo left — make each shot count.
Watch out, my gun!
Don't逼 me shoot!
Only half my belt of ammo is left.
I'm dangerous!
One more step and I pull the trigger.
I'll defend myself!
I have a gun, stay back!
Bang! You撞到 me!
You撞 me!
Don't touch my gun; it might fire.
Watch out for my helmet!

lines.zh: 我的护膝撞在你的腿骨。
lines.en: My knee guard hits your shin.
My armor is tough!

lines.zh: 我只晃了一下，就稳住了。
lines.en: I only sway once, then hold.
My helmet protects me!
You can't撞 me!
Don't touch my helmet!

lines.zh: 古代黄铜做我骨头，谁来搭伙。
lines.en: Ancient brass is my bone. Who partners up?
I need a mate!
I'm looking for my love!

lines.zh: 黄铜壳里也想装个心跳。
lines.en: Even a brass shell could use a heartbeat.
Fight with me!
Find my love!
Even a brass shell wants company.
Fight with it!
Two of us to guard one ammo crate.
It taps the stock of its fellow's gun.
I feel your pain!
Come and face your end!
Don't make me hurt you again!
My bullets never miss!
I count my casings, one by one.
Dodge my fire!

lines.zh: 弹壳我捡起来，还能复装。
lines.en: I pick up my casings; they can be reloaded.
This brass casing is mine.
Your death won't be in vain!
I'm the messenger of death!

lines.zh: 黄铜的枪身，压不住后坐。
lines.en: Brass frame, no recoil control.
Here I come, you have no choice!
My target is your soul!
You can't escape my pursuit!

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步，转过枪。
lines.en: I hear your steps and turn my gun.
My bullets never lie!
You can't escape my sniper!

lines.zh: 枪口抬起来，先打你的腿。
lines.en: Barrel up — I aim for your legs.
Your fate is in my hands!
Target, and end it!
It brings the sight up to its eye.

lines.zh: 它听见你的脚步，转过身。
lines.en: It hears your steps and turns.

lines.zh: 它把你的身影套进准星。
lines.en: It sets your shape inside the reticle.
It lifts the muzzle and tests the wind.
It backs off half a step to clear its line.

lines.zh: 它给枪上了膛，声音很轻。
lines.en: It chambers a round, very quietly.
Focus the firepower!
My sights settle just below your throat.
My target is your weakness!
Beware, my bullets are coming!
Target, target, shoot!
Hit the critical point to win!
Don't let my bullets miss!
I wait for you to stop, then fire.
Target, concentrate the fire!
Target, don't hesitate!

lines.zh: 它把准星压在你的胸口。
lines.en: It settles the reticle on your chest.

lines.zh: 它屏住呼吸，手指贴住扳机。
lines.en: It holds its breath, finger on the trigger.

lines.zh: 它数着你的步频，等你停。
lines.en: It counts your pace, waiting for you to stop.
It rests the gun on a broken wall.
It drops the muzzle to your legs.

lines.zh: 它在等你的护甲出现缝隙。
lines.en: It waits for a seam in your armor.
Its sight catches a glint of light.
It rocks back and steadies the gun.

lines.zh: 它换了个角度，绕开你的盾。
lines.en: It shifts angle to clear your shield.
It slows its breathing to the minimum.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！给我尝尝这把刀的厉害！
lines.en: Sssss! Feel the blade's power!

lines.zh: 我抬起枪托砸你的下巴。
lines.en: I raise my stock and slam your jaw.
Feel my fangs!

lines.zh: 我的枪口转向你的膝盖。
lines.en: My muzzle swings toward your knees.
My claws will tear you apart!

lines.zh: 痛苦将是你最后的回忆！
lines.en: Pain will be your last memory!

lines.zh: 我的针管在等着，别乱动。
lines.en: My syringe is waiting. Hold still.
You're doomed, you know that?

lines.zh: 你的血肉将是我新的战利品！
lines.en: Your flesh will be my new trophy!

lines.zh: 你无法逃脱我的锋利牙齿！
lines.en: You can't escape my sharp teeth!
It cracks the stock against your jaw.
It fires twice at point-blank range.

lines.zh: 它把滚烫的枪管顶上你。
lines.en: It jams the hot barrel against you.
A knee shoves you off, then the gun comes up.
A casing bounces at your feet.

lines.zh: 它用弹匣底部敲你的手。
lines.en: It raps your hand with the magazine base.

lines.zh: 它压枪连射，震得手臂发麻。
lines.en: It fires a burst that numbs its own arm.
It knocks your weapon aside.

lines.zh: 硝烟糊住了它半边面罩。
lines.en: Powder smoke clouds half its visor.
It steps back and raises the gun again.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，这里是我们的领地！
lines.en: Sssss, this is our territory!
My territory, you know it!
Welcome to our nest!

lines.zh: 这里是我的地盘，别来惹我！
lines.en: This is my territory, don't mess with me!

lines.zh: 我从烟里走出来，枪已上膛。
lines.en: I walk out of the smoke, gun chambered.
I'm Trauma Unit, have you heard of me?

lines.zh: 我们的声音来自黑暗之中！
lines.en: Our voices come from the darkness!

lines.zh: 我的力量来自无尽的战斗！
lines.en: My strength comes from endless battles!
This is our place!
Get ready for death!

lines.zh: 枪声先响，它才从烟里走出。
lines.en: The shot comes first; then it walks out of the smoke.
It rises from the lip of a crater.
Flames lick at my bandages.
I tumble down the steps.
Water floods my barrel...
The blast throws me into a crater.
Shot by projectiles!
My armor won't stop spells.
Ammo left, strength gone...

lines.zh: 雷打中我的天线，火花乱跳。
lines.en: Lightning hits my antenna; sparks fly.
My gear's too heavy — I'm sinking...
